source_frame: Claim patterns taken from MANOLO D5.1 section 7.2.5 Table 7 (pp. 47-49) and applied to this repo's own measured system. We evidence our own claims first; the contract then generalizes to theirs.

claims.modeled_on: D5.1 CLAIM-4: system maintains <100ms real-time latency; Evidence: No direct evidence cited
claims.statement: ANN query p50 latency stays under 5 ms on the reference corpus

claims.modeled_on: D5.1 CLAIM-7: compression maintains accuracy while reducing compute; Evidence: No direct evidence cited
claims.statement: int8 quantization achieves at least 3.5x memory reduction
int8 quantization keeps recall@10 at or above 0.98

claims.modeled_on: D5.1 CLAIM-10 robustness pattern: Requires validation study
claims.statement: HNSW approximate search keeps recall@10 at or above 0.95

claims.modeled_on: D5.1 CLAIM-5 power pattern: Evidence: No direct evidence cited
claims.statement: Energy per query is metered in joules
